title: Sanctions screening
description: Decide whether a counterparty's sanctions screening run came back clear or matched, from the match count the run recorded. This is the upstream decision vendor onboarding consumes: its outcome is the value onboarding reads at /vendor/sanctionsScreening/status, declared as a graph edge instead of copied in by hand. Synthetic demo content; it authorizes nothing.

decision.intent: Establish the screening decision for one counterparty from the recorded screening run, so downstream decisions consume a decision rather than a transcribed value.
decision.question: Did the sanctions screening run come back clear for this counterparty, or did it match?

evidenceRequirements.description: The screening run's recorded result for this counterparty, naming the lists searched and the match count.

sources.title: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control

citation.excerpt: Screening a counterparty against the SDN and consolidated lists is public and free; a match blocks the transaction pending review.

sources.rights: Public U.S. government data; cited as the screening source.

outcomes.label: Clear
outcomes.description: The screening run recorded no potential match.

outcomes.label: Match
outcomes.description: The screening run recorded at least one potential match.

rules.description: Clear the counterparty when the recorded match count is exactly zero.
rules.rationale: A missing or unreadable match count is not a clean screening; escalating is preferred to guessing.

rules.description: Report a match when the recorded match count is one or more.
rules.rationale: A count that cannot be ordered against one is not a count this pack can act on.

escalation.message: Escalate to Compliance: state what is unknown or missing about the screening run, and do not treat the counterparty as screened while the escalation is open.
